description: This file implements the HypergeometricDistribution class, providing methods for probability calculations, statistical properties, and distribution support bounds related to the hypergeometric distribution.

classes.name: HypergeometricDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the hypergeometric distribution, providing probability calculations, statistical properties, and distribution support bounds.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative probability P(X <= x) for the distribution.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Returns the domain (lower and upper bounds) for the distribution based on parameters.

methods.name: getLowerDomain
methods.description: Calculates the minimum successful draws in the distribution for given parameters.

methods.name: getUpperDomain
methods.description: Calculates the maximum successful draws in the distribution for given parameters.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability P(X = x) for a given x.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the probability for a given x.

methods.name: innerCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Helper method to sum probabilities within a range in the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: calculateNumericalVariance
methods.description: Computes the variance based on distribution parameters.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution's support.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support of the distribution is connected.
